statements.t: The Notice has no immediate effect on the listing of the Company’s common stock, which will continue to be traded on The Nasdaq Global Market, subject to our compliance with the other Nasdaq listing requirements.

If, at any time during this compliance period, our MVLS closes at $50,000,000 or more for a minimum of 10 consecutive business days, Nasdaq will provide us written confirmation of compliance and this matter will be closed.
If we do not regain compliance with the minimum MVLS requirement before the expiration of the compliance period, we will receive written notification that its securities are subject to delisting.
We intend to monitor our MVLS and consider available options to regain compliance with the applicable Nasdaq Listing Rules.

Based on our forecast, we believe it is probable that we will be in compliance with the covenants under the JPM Credit Agreement at each measurement date over the next twelve months.
Our ability to comply with the fixed charge coverage ratio covenant depends on achieving our forecasted operating results and cash flows, which are subject to uncertainties.
There can be no assurance that we will remain in compliance or that, if necessary, we would be able to obtain a waiver or amendment from the lenders on acceptable terms, or at all.

Based on our current cash position, anticipated cash flows from operations, and availability under our Revolver, we believe we will have sufficient resources to meet our working capital needs, capital expenditures, and debt service obligations for at least the next twelve months from the date of issuance of these condensed consolidated financial statements.
We intend to continue to evaluate opportunities to further enhance our capital structure and support our growth strategy.
